A.text: Prokaryotes and chloroplasts have circular DNA where genes carrying the code for cell walls are located.

B.text: Prokaryotes and chloroplasts have 70S ribosomes that are the sites for translation and polypeptide synthesis.

C.text: Prokaryotes and mitochondria have an outer membrane and a separate inner, folded membrane where ATP synthesis occurs.

D.text: Prokaryotes and mitochondria have double-stranded linear DNA where genes carrying coded information are located.
